EvidenceBody: Wenxi remains at a loss after the identified master answers his question about himself with silence; an emperor is at a loss when National Teacher Nanyang Huizhong sits silent after requesting a seamless-stupa design; and in Linji's record the recorded questioner is at a loss after Linji laughs and is then struck. Later records also use it retrospectively: the later Baoshou is at a loss when asked for the original face before his parents were born. The expression names the reported failure to answer; the records do not make the word itself a diagnosis of an inward state.
